body:
## Pull request overview

This PR expands the built-in locale packs with missing `detail`, plus new `view`, `map`, and `workflow` namespaces, and starts wiring `@object-ui/plugin-detail` components to use `useDetailTranslation()` instead of hardcoded UI strings.

**Changes:**
- Added many new translation keys across all built-in locales (10 languages), including new `view`, `map`, and `workflow` namespaces and an expanded `detail` namespace.
- Updated multiple `plugin-detail` subcomponents to use `useDetailTranslation()` for visible labels/tooltips/placeholders.
- Refactored `RecordActivityTimeline` filter labels to be generated from `t(...)`.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 20 out of 20 changed files in this pull request and generated 8 comments.

<details>
<summary>Comments suppressed due to low confidence (2)</summary>

**packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordComments.tsx:127**
* The search input/clear button `aria-label` values are still hardcoded ("Search comments", "Clear search"). Since this PR is wiring translations, these labels should also come from `t(...)` so assistive tech matches the active locale.
```
              <input
                className="w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background pl-8 pr-8 py-1.5 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                placeholder={t('detail.searchComments')}
                value={searchQuery}
                onChange={(e) => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                aria-label="Search comments"
              />
              {searchQuery && (
                <button
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                  onClick={() => setSearchQuery('')}
                  aria-label="Clear search"
                  type="button"
```
**packages/plugin-detail/src/RecordChatterPanel.tsx:186**
* The collapse button uses a hardcoded `aria-label` ("Hide discussion"). Please translate this to match the active locale (likely reuse `detail.hideDiscussion`).
```
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="icon"
                className="h-7 w-7"
                onClick={() => setCollapsed(true)}
                aria-label="Hide discussion"
              >
                <PanelRightClose className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
```
</details>

The pin/unpin action `aria-label` is still hardcoded ("Pin comment"/"Unpin comment"). Please translate it (can reuse `detail.pin`/`detail.unpin`, or add dedicated aria-label keys if you want different wording).
```suggestion
                      aria-label={comment.pinned ? t('detail.unpin') : t('detail.pin')}
```

`placeholder={placeholder || t('detail.writeComment')}` treats an intentionally empty string placeholder as falsy and forces the default translation. If consumers pass `placeholder=""` to suppress placeholder text, this becomes impossible. Consider using nullish coalescing (`placeholder ?? ...`) and keeping the prop default as `undefined` to preserve the distinction.
```suggestion
              placeholder={placeholder ?? t('detail.writeComment')}
```

The button `aria-label` is still hardcoded in English while the `title` is now translated. For screen reader users in non-English locales, this should be localized too (either reuse the tooltip keys or add dedicated `detail.subscribeAriaLabel` / `detail.unsubscribeAriaLabel` keys).
```suggestion
      aria-label={
        subscription.subscribed
          ? t('detail.unsubscribeAriaLabel')
          : t('detail.subscribeAriaLabel')
      }
```

The collapsed-state toggle still uses a hardcoded `aria-label` ("Show discussion"). Since `detail.showDiscussion` was added, consider localizing the aria-label too (either reuse that key or add a dedicated one).
```suggestion
          aria-label={t('detail.showDiscussion', { count: items.length })}
```

The filter `<select>` has a hardcoded `aria-label` ("Filter activity"). To keep accessibility text localized, this should use `t(...)` (you may need a new `detail.filterActivity` key if none exists).
```suggestion
              aria-label={t('detail.filterActivity')}
```

This `<select>` still has a hardcoded `aria-label` ("Filter activity"). To keep accessibility text localized, consider switching it to `t(...)` (you may need to add a new `detail.filterActivity` key).
```suggestion
              aria-label={t('detail.filterActivity')}
```

In this comment-input section, the textarea placeholder is now localized, but the adjacent submit button further down still uses a hardcoded `aria-label` ("Submit comment"). Please localize that aria-label as well to match the active locale.

This "Load more" UI is now localized via `t('detail.loadMore')`, but the same button still has a hardcoded `aria-label` ("Load more activity") a few lines above. Please translate the aria-label too (reuse `detail.loadMore` or add a dedicated key).
